scope: loopback production Next 3111 and synthetic content 3112; no NAS, public deployment or operational webhook
matrix: 2 locales x 2 Chromium viewports x 3 navigation methods x 3 repetitions; one worker, no retries

causes: Eight destination assertions expected a synthetic publication article absent from the Web hub; the real Web page was rendered. Waiting 10s also exceeded the deliberately held body deadline.
One existing control read a partially overwritten lifecycle JSON snapshot. The test-only writer now writes to a sibling temporary file and renames atomically.

limits: Client Link tests use real DOM links and preserve other normal prefetches; route interception only opts the target into server observation but disables browser HTTP cache.
A preserved window marker and zero post-action document requests verify same-document navigation; not merely a changed URL.
The held body is released after destination rendering for menu navigation, and immediately after clicking the held article for article navigation.
Initial server snapshots can precede headers and are not republished on header arrival; prefetchStatus is the browser-observed HTTP status.
Finished responses are server completion evidence, not proof of every browser byte consumed.
Additional foreground RSC requests were observed when clicking the prefetched article, so a single reused HTTP response is not claimed.
Partial error coverage and historical CI classification remain unchanged; tested Link navigation is not every possible production path.
